# nexus operation

Verbs: get, cancel

## Usage

```
nexus operation [flags]
```

## Flags

```
  -h, --help   help for operation
```

## Global flags

```
      --host string   target hosts: configured names, comma-separated, or all (default: NEXUS_HOST, then the default host)
      --verbose       log each request and response status to stderr
```

## Commands

| Command | Description |
| --- | --- |
| [`nexus operation cancel`](nexus_operation_cancel.md) | Cancel an operation |
| [`nexus operation get`](nexus_operation_get.md) | List operations, or with ID, get one operation |
